name: exam-assistant
description: Write and edit exams, tests and SACs in your school's Exam Assistant, and watch them change live.
long_description: Ask Claude to write an exam, add or rewrite questions, or change marks, and the changes appear in Exam Assistant in your browser within a couple of seconds. Claude works in your own exam library (your staff code), only on the school network. If you and Claude change the same question at once, your version is kept.
